summary: Fact: the bounded news set contains no position-specific portfolio news today, but general discovery flagged a Volato/SOAR AI infrastructure deal as a read-through catalyst for data-center builders, power equipment, energy supply, chips, and connectivity names. Watch items should focus on whether the AI-infrastructure theme broadens from direct beneficiaries into commodity, power, and enterprise-workflow exposures already held.
